# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** eight (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Farewell P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v3 ch.Change P33](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0033), [v3 ch.Change P35](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0035), [v3 ch.Farewell P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)</sub>

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Dora is a neat and proper character with a straight nose and gentle, mild hazel eyes. She has chubby fingers and wears long, sleek curls that always remain tidy. Her attire includes a nicely starched white dress fitted with a black sash.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012)_

## Personality

Dora is a lovely, demure, and exceptionally well-behaved child. Known for being quiet, neat, and prim, she carries herself with a composed and placid demeanor that is rarely ruffled. She is industrious and faithful in her little duties, proving to be observant enough to never require being told how to do a task twice. Despite her meek and proper behavior, her systematic and dispassionate nature can make her seem somewhat monotonous.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), +9 more_

## History

Dora was brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as an orphan alongside her twin brother, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). Soon after arriving, she was pumped over with water by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) after he lured her into a pigpen, and he later trapped her inside a toolhouse where she was eventually found by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). During her time at school, Dora grew frightened of the dark after hearing ghost stories from [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md), and she was once kissed in school by Frank Bell. Her long-term future at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) was secured after her uncle, [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), passed away and left money for the twins' care. Later, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) coerced Dora into skipping [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to play and go fishing with the [Cottons](../codex/factions.md#cottons).

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P9](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0009), +15 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--dora.md)

Dora was brought to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alongside her brother, becoming a student under [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) actively cares for Dora, searching frantically for her when she goes missing and discovering that her brother had locked her in a toolhouse.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +6 more_

- Student of  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

Dora is the twin sister of [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md). Her brother often targets her with misbehavior, such as coaxing her into a pigpen, pumping water over her, and locking her in a toolhouse while lying about her whereabouts.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +20 more_

- Sibling of — twin brother and sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +12 more</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dora--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) took in the orphaned Dora to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). The two also serve as traveling companions, such as when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes Dora into town for a trip.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +6 more_
